ethical
倫理
What ethical question would you ask before using someone else's personal story in a presentation?
The ethical question is whether the person understood and agreed to the use. A compelling story does not remove their right to decide.
倫理上的問題是，對方是否理解並同意這種使用。故事再精彩，也不能剝奪他自己決定的權利。
moral
道德
How would you discuss a moral disagreement without assuming the other person had bad intentions?
I would ask which moral concern mattered most to them. We might share a concern but disagree about the best response.
我會問對方最在意哪個道德問題。我們可能有相同顧慮，只是對做法意見不同。
justice
公道
If a teacher punished the wrong student, what would justice look like?
The teacher should admit the mistake and clear the student's name in front of the class. That is what justice looks like, not just telling the student to forget about it.
老師應該承認弄錯，在全班面前還那位同學清白。這才是還他公道，而不是只叫他算了、別再計較。
equity
公平
What could a school do to improve equity for students who cannot afford club equipment?
To improve equity, the school could lend equipment to students who need it. That way, nobody would have to skip a club just because their family has less money.
為了更公平，學校可以把器材借給需要的同學。這樣就不會有人只因為家裡比較不寬裕，就放棄參加社團。
honesty
誠實
What would you do if your teacher marked one of your wrong answers as correct?
I would tell the teacher about the mistake, even if I lost a few points. For me, honesty matters more than a slightly higher score.
我會告訴老師改錯了，就算會被扣幾分也沒關係。對我來說，誠實比多幾分更重要。
integrity
正直
How could a person show integrity when nobody was checking their work?
A person shows integrity by reporting results as they are. Leaving out an inconvenient finding could mislead others even if the work looked better.
沒人檢查時，仍如實報告結果，就是正直。省略不利發現，可能讓成果好看，卻誤導別人。
responsible
負責
What would a responsible organizer do after discovering a mistake in an event plan?
A responsible organizer would explain the mistake and correct the affected arrangements. Blaming a volunteer would not help participants know what to do.
負責的主辦者會說明錯誤，修正受影響的安排。責怪志工，不能讓參加者知道接下來怎麼辦。
accountable
負責
In a group project, how can you make sure everyone stays accountable?
We could write down who is accountable for each part of the project. Then, if something is late, we know exactly who needs to explain and fix it.
我們可以寫清楚每個部分由誰負責。這樣如果有東西遲交，就知道該由誰說明、補救。
transparent
透明
How could a coach make the selection for a school team more transparent?
The coach could announce the selection rules before tryouts. If the process were transparent, students who were not chosen would understand why and know what to improve.
教練可以在選拔前公布標準。如果過程透明，沒被選上的同學也會明白原因，知道要加強哪裡。
consent
同意
Why is it worth asking for consent before posting a group photograph?
Consent matters because people may have reasons not to appear publicly. Being present in a photo does not mean agreeing to every use.
取得同意很重要，因為有人不想公開露面。出現在照片裡，不代表接受照片被任意使用。
confidential
機密
You help in the school office, and a classmate asks about confidential test information. What would you say?
I would tell my classmate that the information is confidential and I cannot share it. If they have questions about the test, they should ask the teacher directly.
我會跟同學說，這是機密資訊，我不能透露。如果他對考試有疑問，應該直接去問老師。
loyal
忠誠
Can you be loyal to a friend while disagreeing with their behaviour?
I can be loyal without defending every action. Speaking privately about a serious concern may help my friend more than automatic agreement.
忠誠不代表要替朋友每個行為辯護。私下說明嚴重的顧慮，可能比一味附和更有幫助。
loyalty
忠誠
When might loyalty to a group conflict with being fair to others?
Loyalty becomes a problem if it asks me to hide unfair treatment. I can care about my group while expecting it to improve.
忠誠如果要求我掩蓋不公平待遇，就成了問題。關心團體，也可以要求它變得更好。
prejudice
偏見
How would you challenge a prejudiced comment without turning the discussion into an attack?
I would question the prejudice in the comment and ask about its basis. I would focus on the assumption rather than insult the speaker.
我會指出話裡的偏見，也問根據是什麼。把焦點放在假設，不人身攻擊說話的人。
bias
偏見
If you were judging a class poster contest, how could you reduce bias?
I would cover the students' names before scoring to reduce bias. Then I would judge each poster only by the criteria we agreed on.
評分前，我會先把同學的名字遮起來，減少偏見。然後只依照大家說好的標準評每張海報。
discrimination
歧視
What would you want an organization to do after someone reported discrimination?
The organization should take the discrimination report seriously and explain the review process. The person reporting it should not face retaliation for speaking up.
有人通報歧視，組織應該認真處理，說明調查流程。提出問題的人，不應因此遭到報復。
stereotype
刻板印象
How could a story challenge a stereotype without simply creating another one?
The story could challenge a stereotype by showing several distinct individuals. One character should not be expected to represent an entire group.
故事可以呈現幾個不同的人，挑戰刻板印象。不應讓單一角色代表整個群體。
assumption
假設
What assumption might you need to check before offering someone help?
I should check the assumption that they want my help. Asking what would be useful respects their knowledge of their own situation.
我得先確認對方需要幫忙這個假設。問他什麼協助有用，也是在尊重他了解自己的處境。
compassion
同情心
How can compassion influence the way you respond to a stranger's mistake?
Compassion could remind me that I do not know their circumstances. I can address the mistake firmly without treating the person as worthless.
同情心提醒我，其實不知道對方經歷了什麼。我可以認真處理錯誤，不把他整個人否定掉。
dignity
尊嚴
What would help preserve someone's dignity when they need practical assistance?
I would protect their dignity by asking before taking over. Offering choices lets the person keep control over the help they receive.
幫忙前先問，不直接接管，才能保留對方尊嚴。提供選擇，也讓他決定要接受什麼協助。
humble
謙虛
How could an experienced person remain humble when teaching a beginner?
They could remain humble by remembering how confusing the first steps felt. Expertise does not make every beginner's question obvious or foolish.
有經驗的人可以想想，自己剛開始也很困惑，保持謙虛。專家覺得簡單的事，不代表新手的問題愚蠢。
courage
勇氣
What everyday action can require courage even without a dramatic risk?
Admitting that I need help can require courage. It means accepting that someone may see a difficulty I would prefer to hide.
承認自己需要幫忙，也需要勇氣。因為別人會看見自己原本想藏起來的困難。
principle
原則
What principle would you want to keep even when it was inconvenient?
I would keep the principle of giving people accurate information. Saving time would not justify hiding an important limitation from them.
我想守住提供準確資訊的原則。不能為了省時間，就把重要限制瞞著不說。
obligation
義務
How would you distinguish a real obligation from pressure to please everyone?
A real obligation comes from an agreed responsibility, not every request I receive. I can be considerate without accepting unlimited demands.
真正的義務來自說好的責任，不是所有收到的請求。我可以體貼別人，但不用無限答應。
